claims.text: Ask: what they're proud of; something funny or wonderful lately; family changes; how they feel as a parent; chances to interact with peers; questions or concerns.
claims.quote: What are you most proud of since our last visit? (If the parent responds, “Nothing,” the health care professional should be prepared with a compliment, such as, “You made time for this visit despite your busy schedule.”) • What is something funny or wonderful that your child has done lately? • What changes have occurred in your family since your last visit? • How are you feeling as a parent? • What types of opportunities does your child have to interact with peers? • What questions or concerns would you like to share with me about your child?
claims.locator: 3 year visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Past medical hx: any specialty or emergency care since the last visit.
claims.quote: received any specialty or emergency care since the last visit?
claims.locator: 3 year visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Family hx: any new health condition or death in the family; if yes, who has or had it, age at onset and diagnosis, or age at death.
claims.quote: developed a new health condition or died? If the answer is Yes: Ascertain who in the family has or had the condition, and ask about the age of onset and diagnosis. If the person is no longer living, ask about the age at the time of death.
